title: The Rev. Thomas Keble
dates: (1826-1903)
---

nephew of [John Keble](/person/798)

He married, first (1851) Cornelia Sarah Cornish (1828-23 Dec 1858) and, secondly (1862) Mary Caroline Turner (b. 1831/2).

He succeeded his father and namesake as Vicar of Bisley.

He was heir and literary executor of his uncle John Keble.
